newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi expected in Tunis.
newsitem.headline: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi expected in Tunis.

text.p: Tunisia strung up signs welcoming Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi and diplomatic sources said he would arrive on Monday for a week-long official visit.
Diplomatic sources said Gaddafi was coming at the invitation of Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali. The two last met in January for a few hours at their common border.
Both countries are members of the Arab Maghreb Union, a regional economic and political grouping set up in 1989 with Algeria, Mauritania and Morocco.
